Cities We Deliver To

Liquor Delivery Across Murfreesboro & Rutherford County

Liquor & Wine Outlet's central Murfreesboro location at 2003 SE Broad Street puts most of Rutherford County within fast DoorDash and Uber Eats range. Here's what each city sees.

Murfreesboro

Fastest delivery times — the store is here. Coverage includes neighborhoods near MTSU, downtown Murfreesboro Square, the Stones River Mall area, Old Fort Parkway, and Mercury Boulevard residential zones. Typical ETA: 30–45 minutes.

Smyrna

North of Murfreesboro along I-24. Delivery available through both DoorDash and Uber Eats with ETAs typically running 40–60 minutes depending on distance from the store and time of day.

La Vergne

Northwestern Rutherford County along I-24 toward Nashville. Coverage typically available; check the app for your specific address at checkout. ETAs run slightly longer than Murfreesboro core.

Christiana & Rockvale

Southern Rutherford County communities. Delivery zones extend here through both platforms during peak coverage hours. Call (615) 624-6928 if your app shows out-of-range — in-store pickup is an option.

Surrounding Rutherford County

Smaller communities and residential areas across Rutherford County that fall within DoorDash and Uber Eats delivery boundaries from 2003 SE Broad Street. Check your address in either app to confirm.

Exact coverage and ETAs depend on the platform (DoorDash or Uber Eats) and your specific delivery address.
